name: Phantom Stars
source:
A new rookie idol band consists of 8 members: 4 males and 4 females. Unfortunately, just a day before their "debut stage", the band's leader, Wolf, had a car accident and was sent to ICU. The investigator believes that this is not an accident, but a plan thoroughly conspired by someone. However, the band's executive has to hush this news. Also, the press conference and debut date can't be postponed.

It's time for "you", a young police detective, to go undercover as a new band leader for a graceful debut. The player has to investigate the 7 members along with the team officers. Identify who the real culprit is and be careful! Do not let others know who you are!

Watch out! You may give in because of these 7 idols. Stay focused on your mission, do not go after and flirt with them instead.

[From [url=https://tripletriostudiothailand.itch.io/phantom-stars]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新人偶像乐队由8名成员组成：4男4女。不幸的是，就在他们“首演舞台”的前一天，乐队队长沃尔夫遭遇车祸，被送往重症监护室。调查人员认为，这并非一次意外，而是有人精心策划的计划。然而，乐队的高管不得不对这个消息保密。另外，记者招​​待会和出道日期也不能推迟。

年轻警探“你”以新乐队队长的身份卧底，优雅登场。玩家必须与队长一起调查这7名成员。找出真正的罪魁祸首并小心！不要让别人知道你是谁！

当心！你可能会因为这7个偶像而屈服。专注于你的使命，不要去追求和调情他们。

[来自[url=https://tripletriostudiothailand.itch.io/phantom-stars]itch.io[/url]]
